description: Performance over the last 7, 30 or 90 days (Studio, Pro and Agency): post totals vs previous period, engagementRate, byKind format breakdown, daily trend, per-network and campaign byTag rollups, topic and content-pillar rollups for posts linked via topics_link (byTopic, byPillar), top 5 posts, bestTimes, hashtags, shortLinks clicks, audience followers/growth, sync status, and failed-delivery counts by kind (failures). Filter via source ("all", "spica", "native") or tag. If sync.accountsSynced < sync.accountsEligible, run results_sync once to pull full account history. Includes `google` (Google Business Profile calls, directions, websiteClicks, views; null if unconnected) and `searchConsole` (Google Search Console clicks, impressions, ctr, position, queries, pages) when connected. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

days.description: How far back to look: 7, 30 or 90 days. 30 when left out.

source.description: Which posts to include: "all" (Spica + synced native posts, default), "spica", or "native".

tag.description: Optional campaign tag such as "spring-launch" to filter metrics and top posts to that campaign.

name: results_get
title: Read how posts did
